_comment: Single source of truth for the coding-agent backends behind /api/chat. The web server loads this and exposes it at GET /api/coding-agents so the UI can populate the top-left Agent + Model dropdowns. To add a model, append to the backend's `models` array (the UI also offers a free-text 'Custom...' entry). `defaultModel: ""` means 'let the CLI / env decide' (preserves prior behavior). `binEnv` names the env var that overrides the CLI binary path.

grok.label: Grok Build
grok._models_note: Real IDs verified via `grok models` (account xiaokang.ye, 2026-06-04). Only grok-build + grok-composer-2.5-fast are accepted; composer-2.5 / grok-4 error as 'unknown model id'. Higher xAI tiers may unlock more — use the UI 'Custom...' entry to add them.
